original_test_intent: Read the BMC's current automatic/manual fan-control mode and the complete PWM-duty vector for the installed fan population, then correlate those reported values with live fan and thermal state.
original_method: Retain both source request forms and the Request N/A statement; do not choose one silently. After the target firmware contract resolves the request, execute one bounded read and decode exactly the approved response length.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies the firmware-scoped 0x30/0x22 request and response contract, resolves selector versus empty-request behavior, and approves the installed fan order and response-length oracle.
required_inputs: Verified BMC/SUT identity and firmware family
Decision on Ethernet Interface Select presence and value
Installed fan count and byte-to-fan mapping
Mode and PWM field encoding including reserved/unsupported values
safety_requirements: Do not guess or probe selector values
Do not issue 0x30/0x21 or any fan write
Validate completion and exact response length
Reject impossible PWM values and unknown trailing bytes
Do not infer absent PWM bytes while automatic mode is active
agent_execution_scope: Verify the target and approved OEM contract
Capture fan inventory, tachometers, temperatures and control-state context
Construct exactly one approved in-band or OOB 0x30/0x22 request
Capture the full redacted request and response
Validate completion, length, mode and every fan index
Correlate each reported PWM with the named tachometer and thermal context
Archive unknown fields and a no-mutation audit
engineer_actions: Approve fan population, response schema and parser
Review any mode/PWM versus tach/thermal inconsistency

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The empty OOB request may be correct for one transport, but the source simultaneously requires an in-band selector while saying Request N/A; using the DeepSeek command as universal authority would discard that conflict.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After the Wistron contract is approved, issue exactly one secret-safe raw 0x30 0x22 [approved-interface-selector-if-required] request, validate its completion and target-specific length, then decode mode plus exactly the installed fan count of PWM bytes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source's 10/5 timing, mode values and 0-100 percent PWM byte range are retained; selector presence, fan count and expected operating values are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Pin request framing and response cardinality to the BMC firmware, preserve the raw frame, and compare each decoded fan entry with an independently named tachometer and temperature context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces an exit-code-only check with schema validation and physical plausibility evidence while retaining a read-only boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: This snapshot cannot prove that Set Fan Speed Control accepts writes, applies transitions or restores automatic mode.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A variable-length OEM response can be shifted or truncated; a plausible PWM byte associated with the wrong fan can conceal failed cooling or a stale manual-control state.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish or vendor inventory may supplement the raw response only when it exposes the same control mode and every per-fan duty value with a documented identity mapping; it does not resolve the original raw-request coverage by itself.
expected_evidence: Resolved request path and selector decision
Installed fan inventory and byte-index map
Redacted full raw request/response and completion
Decoded mode and complete per-fan PWM vector
Named tachometer/temperature correlation and preserved BMC/OS/SEL evidence
No fan, configuration, power or log mutation audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The in-band Procedure supplies an Ethernet Interface Select byte, the OOB Procedure supplies no request byte, and the note declares Request N/A. These mutually inconsistent framings for 0x30/0x22 require a firmware-specific Wistron ruling before one is executed.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only purpose and response concepts are clear. The vendor contract, fan map and parser are identifiable inputs, so this is a package/user-confirmation gate rather than an irreducible semantic blocker.

review_improvement: Prevents silent selection of the empty-request variant, validates variable response cardinality and makes per-fan physical plausibility part of the evidence without allowing a control write.
independent_technical_reasoning: Mode determines whether PWM bytes are meaningful, and the response length depends on the actual fan population. Therefore a successful OEM completion with an unverified request or fan count can still yield a shifted or incomplete decode. The correct static-review boundary is read-only but contract-gated: resolve framing first, preserve all bytes, and correlate every decoded entry with the named hardware sensor.
